title: The internet discovers TLA+. Now what?
summary: A blog post discussing the growing popularity of TLA+ (Temporal Logic of Actions) among developers and providing guidance on how to get started with this formal specification language for system design and verification.
problem_solved: Demystifies formal methods and helps developers understand when and how to apply TLA+ for system design and bug prevention.
why_valuable: TLA+ can catch subtle concurrency bugs and design flaws that traditional testing misses, potentially saving significant debugging time in complex distributed systems.
